scripts.build:chrome: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome tsc && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=chrome node ./scripts/build-manifest.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox tsc && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox vite build --config vite.content.config.ts && cross-env TARGET_BROWSER=firefox node ./scripts/build-manifest.mjs firefox
